name: io.github.urbandiver/local-deepwiki-mcp
description: Privacy-focused MCP server for DeepWiki-style docs, RAG Q&A, and code analysis

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: OpenAI API key for embeddings and LLM generation

environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Anthropic API key for Claude LLM generation

environmentVariables.name: DEEPWIKI_LLM_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: LLM provider to use: openai, anthropic, or ollama (default: openai)

environmentVariables.name: DEEPWIKI_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: Embedding provider: local or openai (default: local)
